question.text: As per SEBI (Custodian) Regulations, 1996, what is the minimum net worth requirement for a custodian?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 401, an applicant for a custodian registration must have a net worth of at least Rs. 75 crore, effective from 24.03.2026. The Trap: The other options are plausible-looking round-number net-worth thresholds that do not match the custodian-specific requirement on page 401. Note: Net worth for this purpose means paid-up capital plus free reserves as on the date of the application.
